tests.title: A baseline Infinity Events query completes (log availability / retention sanity)
Infinity Events has recorded security events within the lookback window
Critical-severity events are not left unacknowledged past the triage SLA
Infinity XDR/XPR has produced detections or incidents within the lookback window
High and critical XDR/XPR incidents are not open past the triage SLA
XDR/XPR incidents are not left un-progressed past the review window
Harmony Endpoint devices have checked in within the staleness threshold
The assigned Endpoint policy keeps Anti-Malware, Anti-Ransomware and Threat Emulation enabled
Endpoint anti-malware signature age is within the threshold
No unresolved high-severity endpoint incidents past the review window
